risk_summary: The excerpt is primarily standardized forward-looking-risk language, with extensive broad and non-quantified contingencies spanning economic, regulatory, operational, geopolitical, and funding risks. Specific disclosure of the 2023 bank failures, $29.9 million FDIC special assessment, and deposit-balance metrics adds useful quantification, but the overall tone remains cautious and heavily reliant on boilerplate safe-harbor language.
